hypothesis: Replace the Parent's one-canonical-view surrogate treatment with bounded graph-equivalent SMILES-view marginalization: give every task-local oracle-scored graph the same fixed set of five views (its canonical SMILES plus four seeded randomized traversals) carrying the same returned score, fit the otherwise unchanged exact sequence GP to those views, and average posterior moments over the same five-view representation whenever surrogate reward or expected improvement is computed for a graph.
method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: greedy batch expected improvement over only fresh inner-policy samples
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus-only language-model pretraining plus online surrogate fitting, true-reward anchor updates, and oracle-free surrogate-reward inner updates
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: disposable inner-policy optimization against the surrogate posterior mean followed by ancestral de novo sampling and batch acquisition from a newly generated ephemeral set
method_tags.representation: autoregressive SMILES policy with corpus-trained sequence embeddings for a task-local probabilistic surrogate

activation_observables.measurement: After every surrogate refit, use the same cached five exact graph-equivalent views of the fixed ten initial probe graphs to query (a) the production five-view surrogate and (b) a diagnostic Parent-matched surrogate fit to the same graph-score table using only canonical views. For each graph and fit, compute the mean absolute deviation of its five per-view posterior means around their graph average, then report the pooled paired production-minus-Parent change and the fraction of refits whose mean disagreement decreases. Retain every view string, token ids, generation attempt and derived seed, round-trip canonical identity, source observation and repeated score, distinct-view count, fallback count, and both per-view posterior means. Also log that each production inner-reward and acquisition call consumed exactly five views per graph and that its returned graph mean and covariance reproduce averaging of the recorded view-level moments. The mechanism activates only if all labels remain graph- and task-aligned, production predictions are actually marginalized, and pooled equivalent-view posterior disagreement decreases relative to the canonical-only diagnostic.

applicability_conditions: The oracle objective is a property of the molecular graph and therefore assigns the same target to valid SMILES traversals that canonicalize to that graph.

Oracle-scored and generated graphs usually admit several distinct randomized SMILES that remain tokenizable by the frozen vocabulary; bounded validated-view reuse preserves a finite fallback for symmetric or otherwise low-serialization graphs.

The frozen recurrent representation has traversal-dependent variation that same-label view augmentation can regularize; the mechanism is weaker if canonical and randomized embeddings are already effectively identical.
Five equal view slots per graph and the inherited GP noise keep the expanded exact covariance fit positive definite and within the supplied task resources.

View-marginalized posterior moments improve ranking only when weak surrogate guidance is partly caused by SMILES serialization sensitivity. They may not help when the dominant limitation is absent generator support, a reward-discontinuous kernel geometry, or an objective whose useful region is disconnected from the fresh clone samples.

All augmented views, GP state, and diagnostics remain task-local, and no view creates an oracle observation, candidate-library lookup, cross-task transfer, or change to candidate-side canonical identity and duplicate rejection.

Node n-a1feb7fbd3ae establishes exact graph-equivalent traversal generation and learnable randomized-view pressure in a different sequence-policy mechanism, but it does not isolate posterior consistency or acquisition ranking and is not treated as a prior test of this surrogate-specific claim.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if any retained augmented view fails to round-trip to its source canonical graph, receives a score from another graph or task, or enters oracle submission; if production inner-reward or acquisition predictions still use one view rather than the registered five-view moment average; or if pooled within-graph posterior-mean disagreement on the fixed equivalent-view probes is not lower than the paired canonical-only diagnostic despite nontrivial distinct-view coverage.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep corpus preparation and artifacts, the frozen prior and representation weights, persistent true-reward anchor updates, disposable-clone optimization rule and bounds, ancestral de novo generation, fresh-pool construction, greedy expected improvement, canonical identity filtering, duplicate rejection, protocol messages, and all fallbacks outside surrogate representation unchanged. In run mode, cache for each task-local canonical graph a deterministic five-slot representation set derived only from the init seed and graph identity: retain the canonical view, attempt a bounded number of seeded RDKit randomized traversals for four additional distinct tokenizable views, require every retained view to round-trip to the same canonical identity, and fill any exhausted slot only with an already validated view while recording that fallback. Expand each oracle observation into exactly five aligned GP rows with its one real score repeated, so every graph retains equal training weight and no augmented view is submitted to the oracle. For every inner-training candidate, policy probe, and ephemeral acquisition-pool graph, obtain the GP posterior over its cached five views and reduce it to one graph posterior by averaging the five means and all corresponding view-pair covariance blocks; use only those graph-level moments in the inherited reward normalization and greedy-EI code. Alongside the production augmented fit, construct a parent-matched one-canonical-view GP solely for the registered diagnostic, never for proposal decisions.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace the Parent's one-canonical-view surrogate treatment with bounded graph-equivalent SMILES-view marginalization: give every task-local oracle-scored graph the same fixed set of five views (its canonical SMILES plus four seeded randomized traversals) carrying the same returned score, fit the otherwise unchanged exact sequence GP to those views, and average posterior moments over the same five-view representation whenever surrogate reward or expected improvement is computed for a graph.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf represents every oracle-scored molecular graph and every generated query by exactly one canonical SMILES trajectory in its frozen, order-sensitive recurrent embedding. Its surrogate mechanics themselves were operationally sound: all 150 fits were positive definite, every unique observation was represented, fresh-pool yield was 0.7476092896174863, and every selected batch exactly maximized the registered acquisition. The unresolved limiting behaviour is the usefulness of that single-view posterior signal: surrogate-reward inner movement was positive in only 107 of 145 rounds and, on sitagliptin_mpo, in only 10 of 29 rounds with mean lift -0.0008997014785822447 and final Top-1 0.11258212608662879; expected-improvement lift also approached the numerical floor late in search. Those outcomes do not prove serialization sensitivity, but they leave single-trajectory conditioning as a concrete causal bottleneck to test after validity, assimilation, and selection correctness have already activated. Node n-a1feb7fbd3ae shows that graph-equivalent views are operationally available under the campaign vocabulary: all 1,425 selected graphs there supplied four distinct tokenizations with exact round-trip identity and randomized-view target gaps decreased in aggregate, although that node changed sequence-policy replay rather than surrogate fitting and therefore does not settle this mechanism.

applicability_conditions: The graph-invariant-label condition is supported for this benchmark replica: every retained view round-tripped to its source canonical graph, all 1,500 final task-qualified training graph/score pairs exactly matched the evaluator trajectories, each score was repeated across exactly five internal rows, and no augmented view entered an oracle submission.

Distinct tokenizable traversals were broadly available under the frozen vocabulary. All ten fixed probes had five distinct views in every one of 150 refits; among the 1,500 scored graphs at the final refits, 1,498 had five distinct views, one had three, and one had one. Across all production prediction records, 49,730/49,736 graph appearances had more than one distinct view, while validated fallback preserved five slots for the remaining cases.

The posterior-consistency effect is supported across tasks, not only in the pooled mean: every task's mean change was negative and all 30 refits in every task reduced mean disagreement. The evidence is specific to the inherited frozen recurrent embedding, exact RBF GP, five equal view slots, GP noise variance 0.03, and the ten fixed initial probes.

The expanded exact fit remained numerically and operationally feasible from 50 through 1,500 view rows per task: all 150 production fits and all 150 canonical controls were positive definite, and formal task wall times ranged from 43.718063628999516 to 52.018504195002606 seconds under the supplied 3,600-second task timeout.

The decision-path marginalization condition is fully supported for the implemented two-cycle inner update and fresh-pool acquisition: 290 inner-reward and 145 acquisition calls queried exactly five registered views for every graph, and all logged mean and covariance reconstruction residuals were 0.0. This does not establish transfer to another view count, approximate GP, kernel, noise model, or acquisition rule.

A general score or ranking benefit is not supported. The single-replica macro fell materially, with gains on two tasks, a tie on one, and losses on two; applications should therefore require an out-of-sample ranking or calibration check rather than infer utility solely from lower equivalent-view disagreement.

Evidence is limited to seed 0, batch size 10, 29 adaptive rounds per task, five frozen benchmark objectives, and a 300-call budget. Cross-seed reliability and objectives whose score is not invariant to representation are outside the supported applicability range.

observable_measurements.parent_value: The pre-registered Parent-matched baseline is the canonical-only diagnostic fit after every candidate refit to exactly the same graph-score table. Its pooled equivalent-view posterior-mean disagreement was 0.008953833366418666, with a per-refit range of 0.00010918922412261603 to 0.028968648709517028. Its task-level means were deco_hop 0.007312827460815334, drd2_docking 0.0020071434289196033, median_2 0.009121023807285127, sitagliptin_mpo 0.0021098579743240834, and zaleplon_mpo 0.02421831416074918. All 150 controls had one canonical training row per graph, used the same repeated-refit graph scores as production, were positive definite, and were marked diagnostic-only. The formal Parent n-c555e44c6daf independently confirms the implementation baseline: all 150 of its assimilation records report canonical_views_per_observation 1, its source fits the GP directly to canonical embeddings, and it has no graph-equivalent-view prediction or disagreement event. The same-table diagnostic, rather than the Parent's diverged proposal trajectories, is the registered paired comparator.
observable_measurements.value: Seed 0 completed all 150 expected surrogate refits across the five task sessions, 30 per task. Every refit evaluated the same cached five distinct graph-equivalent views, with no fallback, for each of its ten fixed initial probe graphs. Pooling the 1,500 graph/refit probe cases, the production five-view surrogate's per-refit mean absolute posterior-mean disagreement was 0.0024276495537555822, versus 0.008953833366418666 for the same-table canonical-only control, for a paired production-minus-control mean change of -0.006526183812663081. The per-refit change ranged from -0.022216870379511852 to -0.00007752324450513507 and was negative on 150/150 refits; 1,477/1,500 individual graph/refit cases decreased, a fraction of 0.9846666666666667. Each task decreased on all 30 refits. Task-level production mean, control mean, and paired change were deco_hop 0.001765824897210387, 0.007312827460815334, and -0.00554700256360494; drd2_docking 0.0004468134883714432, 0.0020071434289196033, and -0.0015603299405481535; median_2 0.0021292559810629497, 0.009121023807285127, and -0.006991767826222178; sitagliptin_mpo 0.0007285768496683967, 0.0021098579743240834, and -0.0013812811246556964; and zaleplon_mpo 0.007067776552464736, 0.02421831416074918, and -0.017150537608284437. Recomputing every graph MAD from its five recorded posterior means agreed with the logged graph values to maximum floating residual 1.1622647289044608e-16, and recomputing each refit aggregate agreed to maximum residual 6.028164079019405e-17. All 150 production and control fits were positive definite. Across the complete run, 23,250 logged training-graph appearances supplied 116,250 aligned five-view rows; the final five tables contained 1,500 task-qualified oracle observations, and independent comparison with the five evaluator trajectories matched every canonical identity and score exactly. Every retained training and probe view round-tripped to its source canonical identity, carried that source graph's exact score, and retained its view string, token ids, derived seed, generation attempt, fallback state, and posterior values; no cached canonical identity had inconsistent view metadata across refits. The production path emitted 290 inner-reward calls over 21,224 graphs and 145 acquisition calls over 17,407 graphs, hence 193,155 view queries for 38,631 decision-path graphs at exactly five views each. Including the paired before/after policy probes, all 725 production prediction calls covered 49,736 graphs and 248,680 view queries. Every call logged uniform averaging of five means and all view-pair covariance blocks with maximum mean-aggregation and covariance-aggregation residual exactly 0.0, and every augmented-view oracle-submission count was zero. The predicted intermediate behavior therefore occurred.

possible_failure_causes: Activation did not produce the pre-registered terminal-score effect on this replica. The trusted seed-0 candidate macro is 0.35418395563013 versus Parent 0.513626533890974, a paired difference of -0.15944257826084401. Candidate-minus-Parent Top-1 changes were -0.060284036498868154 on zaleplon_mpo, +0.21200803045604244 on deco_hop, -0.9675346453648044 on drd2_docking, 0.0 on median_2, and +0.0185977601034132 on sitagliptin_mpo. This mixed and materially worse outcome does not negate the confirmed intermediate mechanism.

The registered disagreement probes are the ten initial scored graphs and therefore remain represented in every production training table. Their decisive in-table serialization consistency does not establish more accurate ordering or calibrated uncertainty on fresh de novo candidates; the score evidence shows that posterior invariance alone was insufficient, especially on drd2_docking.

Five same-label rows per graph retain equal graph-to-graph weight but change the likelihood geometry under the inherited per-row GP noise. This can suppress useful uncertainty or over-smooth traversal-sensitive distinctions as well as remove nuisance variation. Consistent with that possible limitation, candidate selected-minus-pool-mean expected-improvement lift was exactly zero on 140/1,450 selection steps and averaged 0.00010966129333045871, versus no exact-zero step and mean 0.00023562587501990017 for the Parent; these unpaired, trajectory-dependent diagnostics do not by themselves identify the score-loss cause.

The altered surrogate reward led to a somewhat less productive proposal distribution. Candidate fresh-pool yield was 17,407 eligible unique graphs from 25,152 ancestral draws, 0.6920722010178118, versus Parent 17,512 from 23,424, 0.7476092896174863. Every candidate round still supplied at least 80 eligible graphs and filled all ten slots, so this is a possible efficiency and exploration limitation rather than an activation failure.

Bounded reuse cannot create traversal diversity for every molecule. At the final refits, 1,498/1,500 scored graph records had five distinct views, one had three distinct views with two fallback slots, and one had only its canonical view with four fallback slots. The fixed diagnostic probes all had five distinct views, so they do not measure behavior on the rare no-diversity case.

Only screening seed 0 was evaluated. It establishes execution and the predicted paired disagreement decrease across all five task sessions, but not multi-seed stability, out-of-sample calibration, or a reliable terminal-score benefit.

The expanded exact fit remained numerically and operationally feasible from 50 through 1,500 view rows per task: all 150 production fits and all 150 canonical controls were positive definite, and formal task wall times ranged from 43.718063628999516 to 52.018504195002606 seconds under the supplied 3,600-second task timeout.

The decision-path marginalization condition is fully supported for the implemented two-cycle inner update and fresh-pool acquisition: 290 inner-reward and 145 acquisition calls queried exactly five registered views for every graph, and all logged mean and covariance reconstruction residuals were 0.0. This does not establish transfer to another view count, approximate GP, kernel, noise model, or acquisition rule.

A general score or ranking benefit is not supported. The single-replica macro fell materially, with gains on two tasks, a tie on one, and losses on two; applications should therefore require an out-of-sample ranking or calibration check rather than infer utility solely from lower equivalent-view disagreement.

Evidence is limited to seed 0, batch size 10, 29 adaptive rounds per task, five frozen benchmark objectives, and a 300-call budget. Cross-seed reliability and objectives whose score is not invariant to representation are outside the supported applicability range.

applicability_conditions: The oracle objective is a property of the molecular graph and therefore assigns the same target to valid SMILES traversals that canonicalize to that graph.

Oracle-scored and generated graphs usually admit several distinct randomized SMILES that remain tokenizable by the frozen vocabulary; bounded validated-view reuse preserves a finite fallback for symmetric or otherwise low-serialization graphs.

The frozen recurrent representation has traversal-dependent variation that same-label view augmentation can regularize; the mechanism is weaker if canonical and randomized embeddings are already effectively identical.
Five equal view slots per graph and the inherited GP noise keep the expanded exact covariance fit positive definite and within the supplied task resources.

View-marginalized posterior moments improve ranking only when weak surrogate guidance is partly caused by SMILES serialization sensitivity. They may not help when the dominant limitation is absent generator support, a reward-discontinuous kernel geometry, or an objective whose useful region is disconnected from the fresh clone samples.

All augmented views, GP state, and diagnostics remain task-local, and no view creates an oracle observation, candidate-library lookup, cross-task transfer, or change to candidate-side canonical identity and duplicate rejection.

Node n-a1feb7fbd3ae establishes exact graph-equivalent traversal generation and learnable randomized-view pressure in a different sequence-policy mechanism, but it does not isolate posterior consistency or acquisition ranking and is not treated as a prior test of this surrogate-specific claim.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if any retained augmented view fails to round-trip to its source canonical graph, receives a score from another graph or task, or enters oracle submission; if production inner-reward or acquisition predictions still use one view rather than the registered five-view moment average; or if pooled within-graph posterior-mean disagreement on the fixed equivalent-view probes is not lower than the paired canonical-only diagnostic despite nontrivial distinct-view coverage.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep corpus preparation and artifacts, the frozen prior and representation weights, persistent true-reward anchor updates, disposable-clone optimization rule and bounds, ancestral de novo generation, fresh-pool construction, greedy expected improvement, canonical identity filtering, duplicate rejection, protocol messages, and all fallbacks outside surrogate representation unchanged. In run mode, cache for each task-local canonical graph a deterministic five-slot representation set derived only from the init seed and graph identity: retain the canonical view, attempt a bounded number of seeded RDKit randomized traversals for four additional distinct tokenizable views, require every retained view to round-trip to the same canonical identity, and fill any exhausted slot only with an already validated view while recording that fallback. Expand each oracle observation into exactly five aligned GP rows with its one real score repeated, so every graph retains equal training weight and no augmented view is submitted to the oracle. For every inner-training candidate, policy probe, and ephemeral acquisition-pool graph, obtain the GP posterior over its cached five views and reduce it to one graph posterior by averaging the five means and all corresponding view-pair covariance blocks; use only those graph-level moments in the inherited reward normalization and greedy-EI code. Alongside the production augmented fit, construct a parent-matched one-canonical-view GP solely for the registered diagnostic, never for proposal decisions.
research_intent.mechanism: Replace the Parent's one-canonical-view surrogate treatment with bounded graph-equivalent SMILES-view marginalization: give every task-local oracle-scored graph the same fixed set of five views (its canonical SMILES plus four seeded randomized traversals) carrying the same returned score, fit the otherwise unchanged exact sequence GP to those views, and average posterior moments over the same five-view representation whenever surrogate reward or expected improvement is computed for a graph.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf represents every oracle-scored molecular graph and every generated query by exactly one canonical SMILES trajectory in its frozen, order-sensitive recurrent embedding. Its surrogate mechanics themselves were operationally sound: all 150 fits were positive definite, every unique observation was represented, fresh-pool yield was 0.7476092896174863, and every selected batch exactly maximized the registered acquisition. The unresolved limiting behaviour is the usefulness of that single-view posterior signal: surrogate-reward inner movement was positive in only 107 of 145 rounds and, on sitagliptin_mpo, in only 10 of 29 rounds with mean lift -0.0008997014785822447 and final Top-1 0.11258212608662879; expected-improvement lift also approached the numerical floor late in search. Those outcomes do not prove serialization sensitivity, but they leave single-trajectory conditioning as a concrete causal bottleneck to test after validity, assimilation, and selection correctness have already activated. Node n-a1feb7fbd3ae shows that graph-equivalent views are operationally available under the campaign vocabulary: all 1,425 selected graphs there supplied four distinct tokenizations with exact round-trip identity and randomized-view target gaps decreased in aggregate, although that node changed sequence-policy replay rather than surrogate fitting and therefore does not settle this mechanism.
